constraints.text: "Just like peering behind a rock to find a treasure box, inspiration can appear almost anywhere. Just feel for where its breeze nudges you."
constraints.reading: The box sits BEHIND a rock — i.e. tucked into the back side of a natural rock feature, not in front of it and not buried. One would have to step around or peer past the rock to see it.
Spatial orientation hint: the hide is on the far/hidden face of a rock relative to the approaching searcher's line of sight — look around the back, not on top or in front.

constraints.text: The box may be tucked behind a rock rather than buried — consistent with the author's confirmed "not buried" rule; surface-level, exposed to weather.
constraints.reading: Hiding spot is an above-ground natural rock niche; the container rests at or near ground level wedged against/behind stone, not in a hole.

constraints.text: A real natural rock feature, not a planted prop (NOT in fake tree stumps or fake boulders); box wedged behind, under an overhang of, or beside a natural rock.
constraints.reading: The feature is a genuine boulder/ledge/outcrop with a gap, undercut, or overhang large enough to shelter a box-sized case behind or beneath it.

constraints.text: Weather exposure is relevant: the author reported having to check a box was "still safe" after storms; boxes sit in a protective Pelican-type case.
constraints.reading: The spot is open to the elements (rain/wind), implying an exposed rock face or overhang rather than a sealed cave or building — but with enough overhang/shelter that storms threaten but don't destroy it.

constraints.text: Inspiration likened to "a wise breeze blowing in the direction I need to go" and "feel for where its breeze nudges you."
constraints.reading: Recurring wind/breeze imagery could metaphorically hint at a windy, exposed location (a ridge, gap, or overlook where breeze is felt) rather than a sheltered valley.

constraints.text: Ruby "pigeon's blood" deep-red color is the most sought; Burmese ruby glow is "the inextinguishable flame of immortality."
constraints.reading: Deep-red color motif — could echo a reddish rock, red clay/soil, or a sunrise/sunset-facing spot, if color is meant to describe the surroundings of the hide.

constraints.text: Wing-shaped ruby earrings (Angie Marei); Egyptian-revival wing/Isis motifs.
constraints.reading: Wing shape may describe a landform near the hide — a winged/V-shaped rock formation, a pair of symmetric outcrops, or a cliff edge resembling wings.

constraints.text: Sukhothai = "Dawn of Happiness"; ruby is the stone of the Sun in the Noppakao/nine-gem tradition; strong sun/dawn theme.
constraints.reading: Sun/dawn theme may favor an east-facing rock or an overlook positioned to catch sunrise.

constraints.text: Amelia Earhart Birthplace described as on a bluff over the Missouri River; Earthwork on a public hillside next to Warnock Lake.
constraints.reading: Generic spatial pattern surfaced as fact: an elevated bluff/hillside overlooking water — a high vantage beside a body of water — as a type of accessible spot.

constraints.text: None of the boxes more than three miles from a road; reachable within a couple of hours' walk; no high-water crossings; safe.
constraints.reading: The spot lies within 3 miles of a road, no water crossing required to reach it — a moderate off-trail walk from accessible parking.

constraints.text: Author grew up "in the boondocks" near Emerald Hollow Mine; Brushy Mountains foothills setting.
constraints.reading: As a generic terrain descriptor only: a rural, wooded foothills/forest setting (hilly, rocky ground) rather than open plains or urban — surfaced as raw fact, not a location pointer.
